sources.entry: Kimi Claw - OpenClaw is an AI assistant with personality and memory. Kimi deploys it to the cloud for you in one click—no complex setup, online 24/7.

summary.name: Kimi Claw (OpenClaw)
summary.one_liner: A hosted deployment page from Kimi that sets up an OpenClaw AI assistant with memory and scheduled tasks, running 24/7 in the cloud, on your computer, or on an Android phone.
use_cases: Deploy a 24/7 AI assistant to a cloud server
Run a personal assistant on a spare Android phone
Schedule recurring tasks with an AI agent
Chat with an AI assistant across messaging apps
Collaborate with an AI agent in shared groups
summary.what_it_does: The page offers one-click deployment of OpenClaw, described as an AI assistant with personality and memory. Deployment targets are a local computer (managing local files), a cloud server with isolated data, or a spare Android device. Users can also link an existing OpenClaw instance. The page says the assistant is configured with Kimi Instant Thinking and ready-made skills, runs across multiple messaging apps, and can complete tasks proactively. It mentions scheduled tasks and Claw Groups (Preview) for multi-agent and human collaboration.
notable: One-click cloud deployment of OpenClaw with no complex setup
Choice of local computer, cloud server, or Android phone as host
Claw Groups (Preview) for multi-agent and human collaboration
Pre-configured with Kimi Instant Thinking and ready-to-use skills
caveats: Claw Groups is labeled Preview, so it may be unstable or incomplete
Pricing and plan limits are not stated on the page
